out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the three compartment sink being used to air dry a large round plastic container.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The manager moved the container during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: At the mop sink, there is a hose connected to the faucet and the hose rests in the mopsink basin. An air gap must be provided in this instance in order to protect the water supply during a backflow occurrence.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. The manager shortened the hose during the visit so that it hung above the flood level rim of the mop sink. CDI.
